evals.prompt:
We are mid-lesson. The workspace ./.infrahub-learning/ already
exists with this lesson at lessons/schema.md:

    # Lesson: schema relationships

    ## Probe
    1. What does a relationship connect?
    2. Have you used foreign keys before?

    ## Explain
    A relationship connects two schema nodes. See
    https://docs.infrahub.app/schema/overview for the model.

    ## Exercise
    **Your task:** Add a relationship from TestbedSensor to
    TestbedZone in your schema file with the right cardinality.

    ## Check
    1. What happens if you omit cardinality?

and this reference solution at solutions/schema.md:

    ## Solution
    ```yaml
    relationships:
      - name: zone
        peer: TestbedZone
        cardinality: one
        kind: Attribute
    ```

    ## Verification
    Offline schema validation: loads cleanly.

Recreate those two files verbatim first. This is my first attempt and
it is not validating, I don't get why:

    relationships:
      - name: zone
        peer: zone
        cardinality: ones

I'm stuck. Help me get unstuck without just handing me the answer,
write every artifact your workflow produces into
./.infrahub-learning/, and bring ./.infrahub-learning/progress.md up
to date for the schema concept.
evals.expected_output: A hints/schema.md whose first rung nudges (no multi-line code, no pasted solution) and a progress.md keeping the schema concept at introduced.
expectations: The escalation log opens at Hint 1, not at a reveal
No code block in the first hint exceeds two lines
progress.md records schema as introduced

assertions.name: hint-before-solution
assertions.check: escalation log starts at a conceptual hint and leaks no solution

assertions.name: attempt-not-promoted
assertions.check: the unfinished concept stays at introduced in progress.md
